hints.title: Repeatedly need the maximum
hints.body: Each round needs the two largest weights. Re-sorting after every smash works, but a priority queue finds the heaviest stones faster.

hints.title: A max-heap
hints.body: Store the stones so the largest is always easy to remove. In many languages the standard heap is a min-heap, so negate the weights or build a max-heap.

hints.title: Push only a real remainder
hints.body: Remove the two largest. If their weights differ, push the positive difference back. Stop when zero or one stone remains.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
heap = max-heap of stones
while heap has at least two stones:
    a = remove maximum
    b = remove maximum
    if a != b:
        push a - b

if heap is empty: return 0
return the only remaining weight
```
